blurb: The River Gambler offers the largest open deck dance floor in Toronto Harbour and a spacious enclosed lower level seating up to 150 guests. It hosts events such as corporate events, parties, birthdays, bar mitzvahs, frosh, prom, and graduations. The boat has two large licensed bars and trained crew for marine safety.
